notes.title: Tiny Tots 1.0.5 Update Now Live!
notes.content: [p][b]Hey Tots! [/b]We've just dropped the [i]1.0.5 soft build[/i], packed with playtest fixes, smoother UI, improved performance, and hidden surprises. Thanks to your feedback 💪[/p][p][u]Here are all the changes we've made:[/u] [/p][p][/p][h3]🔍 Playtest Bug Fixes[/h3][p]Reorganized Level 1 hints and obstacles for better flow and story progression[/p][p]Removed unnecessary Steam firewall pop-up (game doesn’t use internet)[/p][p]Floor Spike blueprint now properly damages the player[/p][p]Fixed video resolution dropdown — 720p and 1080p were reversed[/p][p][/p][h3]🎛️ UI & Menu Upgrades[/h3][p]Refactored UI widgets for improved efficiency[/p][p]Smoother transitions between menus:[/p][p]Main Menu – Press Start, New Game, Options, Quit[/p][p]Pause Menu – Resume, Retry, Options, Quit to Menu, Quit Game[/p][p]Game Over Menu – Resume, Retry, Restart, Options, Quit to Menu, Quit Game[/p][p]Bonus Menu – Unlockables, Stats, Challenges, Gallery (Coming Soon), Exit to Menu[/p][p]Bonus Stage Clear Screen – Temporarily removed Options button; player can Continue or Quit only[/p][p]Added logic for "Quit to Menu" and "Quit Game" in WB_BackTo[/p][p][/p][h3]🕹️ Gameplay Features & Improvements[/h3][p]Bonus level deaths now show “Continue” on the Game Over screen[/p][p]Returning you to the level you came from[/p][p]Secret Bonus Portals now spawn after collecting Special Coins[/p][p]Mini-games, time trials, or rewards await![/p][p]Improved safe return from bonus levels[/p][p]Level streaming visuals now remain consistent using the updated Level Manager[/p][p][/p][h3]🚧 Early Release Updates[/h3][p]Added “Retry” button to Pause Menu[/p][p]Fixed exploit: No more extra lives from retrying on your last life[/p][p]Bonus Menu unlocks in Main Menu after finishing the game[/p][p]Includes Stats, Challenges, Gallery, and Unlockables[/p][p]Improved audio settings save system [/p][p]Your slider settings now persist between sessions![/p][p][/p][h3]📦 Crate Overhaul & Future DLC Prep[/h3][p]Reduced coin drops from breakable crates[/p][p]More crate drops and collectible item types coming in future DLC![/p][p]Updated breakable crate blueprint (75% complete)[/p][p]Replaced old crate assets across all levels with the new version[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you all for playing, testing, and sharing your thoughts 💬[/h3][h3]More content and surprises are on the way.✨[/h3]

notes.title: Patch 1.03 – Audio, Bouncepad, and Enemy Fixes
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
✅ Fixed Main Audio Options – Music, SFX, and Ambient settings now correctly save and apply in both Main Menu and Pause Menu.

✅ Bounce Pad Bug Fixed – Resolved issue where double jumping caused sound effects to play twice on landing.

🐢 New Enemy Behavior: Pokipine – Introducing the spiked-shelled “Pokipine”!
Jumping on it now causes damage.
Only way to defeat it is with a direct punch (LMB).
Also improved AI movement to make chases feel tighter and more responsive.

Thanks for the feedback! More updates coming soon. 💥

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Progression & Checkpoint Overhaul
notes.content:
[p][b]What’s New:[/b][/p][p]✅ [b]Persistent Spline Progression[/b]
Your character now correctly remains at the spline unlock point after completing a level, ensuring smoother world map navigation and a sense of progression.[/p][p]✅ [b]Advanced Checkpoint Respawn System[/b]
Implemented a reliable checkpoint system across all stages, allowing players to respawn exactly where they left off after dying—no more starting over unless you choose to![/p][p]✅ [b]Fixed Stage 3 Spawn Bug[/b]
Resolved an issue where players would spawn in unintended locations in Stage 3. Spawning is now accurate and predictable.[/p][p]✅ [b]New Game Wipes Previous Progress[/b]
Starting a new game now properly clears any saved level progress, ensuring a clean slate and preventing old data from interfering with fresh playthroughs.[/p][p]✅ [b]Replay Completed Levels[/b]
After completing any level, players can now [b]replay[/b] it from the beginning to improve performance, find hidden items, or experience alternate outcomes.[/p][p][/p][p]✨ [b]Thanks for playing! Stay tuned—more feature drops, seasonal content, and twisted surprises are on the way.[/b][/p][p]📺 [b]Follow us for news and dev updates, and don’t forget to leave a review if you’re enjoying the ride.[/b][/p]

tags.feature:
✅ [b]Persistent Spline Progression[/b]
Your character now correctly remains at the spline unlock point after completing a level, ensuring smoother world map navigation and a sense of progression.

✅ [b]Advanced Checkpoint Respawn System[/b]
Implemented a reliable checkpoint system across all stages, allowing players to respawn exactly where they left off after dying—no more starting over unless you choose to!

tags.bug:
✅ [b]Fixed Stage 3 Spawn Bug[/b]
Resolved an issue where players would spawn in unintended locations in Stage 3. Spawning is now accurate and predictable.

tags.feature:
✅ [b]New Game Wipes Previous Progress[/b]
Starting a new game now properly clears any saved level progress, ensuring a clean slate and preventing old data from interfering with fresh playthroughs.

✅ [b]Replay Completed Levels[/b]
After completing any level, players can now [b]replay[/b] it from the beginning to improve performance, find hidden items, or experience alternate outcomes.

notes.title: Tiny Tots Update – Smarter Retries & Better Guidance!
notes.content: [p][b]🛠️ Tiny Tots Update – Smarter Retries & Better Guidance![/b][/p][p]Hey everyone! We’ve pushed a small but important update based on early feedback. These fixes improve the gameplay flow and make your adventure in [i]Tiny Tots[/i] smoother and more intuitive:[/p][p]🔧 [b]Patch Notes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]Checkpoint & Retry Logic Fixed[/b] – Players now correctly restart from checkpoints or the beginning of the level instead of returning to the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Lives System Adjusted[/b] – Retrying a level now properly handles lives, so you're not unfairly punished for giving it another go.[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Improved Cage Interaction[/b] – A helpful [i]“Press E”[/i] prompt has been added to the cage, guiding players on how to interact and unlock it.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing and sharing your thoughts — it really helps shape the future of [i]Tiny Tots[/i]! More updates coming soon. 🚀[/p]

tags.bug: ✅ [b]Checkpoint & Retry Logic Fixed[/b] – Players now correctly restart from checkpoints or the beginning of the level instead of returning to the main menu.
✅ [b]Lives System Adjusted[/b] – Retrying a level now properly handles lives, so you're not unfairly punished for giving it another go.

tags.feature: ✅ [b]Improved Cage Interaction[/b] – A helpful [i]“Press E”[/i] prompt has been added to the cage, guiding players on how to interact and unlock it.
